content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is strictly on a contractual basis for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and 11 months for civilian candidates, subject to the performance of candidates and other conditions according to the criteria mentioned against each post. Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM), Veer Naris, and Widows of Service Personnel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Solan Bilasapur OIC ECHS Polyclinic
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the application form as per the format given on the official website. Fill out the application form in triplicate. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of educational qualifications and work experiences, along with the discharge book, PPO service records, and 2 passport size photographs. Submit the application by hand to OIC Stn HQ's (ECHS Cell) Kasauli by 02 November 2026 at 4:00 PM. Attend the interview on 20 November 2026 at Stn HQ Kasauli at 9:00 AM, bringing all original certificates, mark sheets, degree/diploma, course work experience, and discharge book.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form in triplicate Self-attested photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets Degree / Diploma / Course certificates Work experience certificates Discharge book PPO service records 2 passport size photographs Valid registration from Himachal Pradesh State Medical / Para Medical Council (for Med/Para Med staff) Original certificates and documents for verification during the interview

faq.question: Q1. Is the appointment permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointments are made on a contractual basis for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and 11 months for civilian candidates.

faq.question: Q2. Who receives preference during the selection process?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM), Veer Naris, and Widows of Service Personnel.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by hand at Stn HQ Kasauli is 02 November 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. When and where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 20 November 2026 at Stn HQ Kasauli at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. Is valid registration mandatory for medical and paramedical staff?
faq.answer: Yes, valid registration from Himachal Pradesh State Medical / Para Medical Council is mandatory for Med/Para Med staff.
